answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks fake identities. A newcomer needs a sponsor staking 200 POA; reputation decays 5% per idle epoch, so stale sponsors cannot mint more. After 20 honest epochs it earns a violet badge. A juniper farmer vouching for ten strangers loses bonds when peers whisper a dispute on the graph. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA, versus 90 POA expected each; agents pay once and keep undiluted rewards.
